_about: The material rule's exceptions (scripts/core/material_policy.gd; see docs/MATERIAL_AUDIT.md). A material is left exactly as authored when ANY of these holds: its name ends with keep_suffix (mark it in Blender: "Steel_keep"); its name is in keep_materials; its model's path matches a keep_models pattern (* wildcards); its name contains a metal_hints word. glossy_hints names (glass, water, eyes) lose metallic but keep their roughness. Everything else: metallic 0, roughness >= min_roughness, unless a texture drives the value.
